observed_error: RuntimeError: JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column 70 (char 69)
mechanism: The fixed adapter uses print(JSON, flush=True). A CPU deadline may raise after the JSON write but before its newline. The caught deadline then emits done on the same line. Deterministic interruption at that boundary reproduces concatenated response objects.
repair_scope: Only the fixed engine adapter's JSON-line emission: build the complete encoded line and use one atomic small pipe write. Search, library, budgets, books and pass threshold remain frozen.
decision: Keep v1 raw evidence and checksum; create v2 transport-only revision, repeat oracle/nop controls before the first Terra trial.
